name: Android offline license supplements and isolated notice producer
timestampSource: Birth time and final modification time of retained command log; exit0 observed from execution envelope.
summary: Maintained isolated debug/release notice producer check passed normal/add/remove graph transitions and twenty damaged controls per variant/phase. Five formerly linked-only records retain offline texts and exact source provenance; JAIN SIP NIST and Sun/BEA notices remain distinct. Production metadata and compiled resource fingerprints unchanged during the isolated test.

All five override contents and SHA-256 provenance matched actual generated debug/release licenses and referencing selected module versions.
NIST warranty/conditions and original Sun/BEA copyright/use-subject-to-license notice retained. Removing API notice while retaining NIST conditions was rejected.
Per variant and phase: four graph/base-license controls, five omitted supplemental texts, five substituted texts, five unlinked references and one missing JAIN SIP API notice rejected.

Existing app build directory and both metadata producer output sets were inside the unique temporary check directory; normal app raw debug/release metadata and compiled release resource SHA-256 values remained unchanged before/after.
Separately executed :app:mergeReleaseResources succeeded. Compiled release raw_aboutlibraries.json.flat contains byte-identical normal release metadata with the five supplements.
Separately executed LibraryNoticesTest: three tests, zero failures/errors/skips. No new native UI run claimed.

Upstream libyuv/WebRTC license snapshots do not prove exact native source or complete third-party payload coverage.
